text_es: Operator, unserved demand and low reserves require careful watching tonight while the southern corridor outage persists under emergency conditions.

delta: Following the outage of the corridor from Centro-Sur to the south, the operator must choose between local battery relief that minimizes line loading or a northern dispatch strategy that yields far superior cost and emissions reductions.

diagnosis_es: Tripping of the trunk corridor from Centro-Sur to the Southern Zone has overloaded the corridor linking Norte Chico to the Central Zone, producing unserved demand in the metropolitan area.

options.title_es: Northern Storage Dispatch and Dynamic Rating
options.rationale_es: Achieves substantially larger economic savings and emission reductions by deploying northern storage alongside emergency capacity on the northern corridor.

options.title_es: Central Battery Support and Corridor Rating
options.rationale_es: Provides immediate local energy injection from the Polpaico battery while maintaining much lower maximum transmission line loading across the network.
